name: Supermicro GPU and HGX systems (8-GPU and 4-GPU nodes)
region: Worldwide; sold direct and through distributors (IT Creations, CDW and others carry Supermicro lines)
notes: QUOTE-ONLY - Supermicro's accelerator pages carry a 'Request Pricing' contact form and no price. The value of this record is the node-level BASELINE, verified from the air-cooled GPU portfolio page, which groups its systems by accelerator rather than by SKU: 'NVIDIA HGX Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra' supporting HGX B200 and B300 (up to 8TB DDR5, 10x PCIe 5.0); 'AMD Instinct MI350X' (up to 6TB DDR5); an '8-10 PCIe GPU' class explicitly for 'AI Factories and Large-scale AI Inference' listing RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition / Max-Q, RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition, AMD Instinct MI350P and NVIDIA H200 NVL; and a '2-6 PCIe GPU' class for enterprise and edge. Concrete example model verified: SYS-521GE-TNRT, a 5U dual-root PCIe system with up to 10 GPUs on the X13DEG-OA board, NVIDIA-Certified. KEY BASIS POINT for anyone budgeting: this class of box is where the accelerator COMES WITH THE SYSTEM. There is no Supermicro SKU 'one H200 SXM'. A published base-system price from a Supermicro channel would exclude GPUs entirely, so a 'Supermicro 5U server' price and a 'Supermicro 8xH200 node' price are not comparable and the former is a trap. Supermicro also builds AMD Helios rackscale.
